result.description: The produced result to assess against task on /task-execution-quality. Also accepted as output or response.

retailer.description: The retailer or store name on /return-policy-verify. Also accepted as store, merchant, or brand.

route.description: Free-text route description on /delivery-window-verify, when origin and destination are not given separately.

service.description: Service level (e.g. ground, express, overnight) on /delivery-window-verify. Optional.

target.description: Target language, tone, or style on /language-generate. Also read from an instruction inside `text` when omitted.

target_language.description: Alias of target on /language-translate. Also accepted as to, language, or langpair ("en|de").

task.description: The original task description on /task-execution-quality. Also accepted as task_description or instructions. Used with result.

team.description: Club or franchise name on /sports-score or /game-result.

text.description: Text to classify on /text-classify, to transform on /language-generate, to summarize on /text-summarize, or to check on /grammar-spell-check and /ai-text-detect.

text1.description: First text to compare on /semantic-similarity. Also accepted as a.

text2.description: Second text to compare on /semantic-similarity. Also accepted as b.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. "AAPL". Required on /stock-price only.

ticket.description: The described error or technical problem on /customer-ticket-resolution. Also accepted as description, issue, problem, error, or error_message.

to.description: Target currency code or name on /currency-exchange, e.g. "EUR" or "euros". Also accepted as an alias of destination on /route-eta and of target_language on /language-translate.

to_year.description: Latest publication year on /academic-search. Read from the question when omitted.

topic.description: Research topic to search for on /academic-search. A whole question is accepted, and a date range stated in it ("since 2020") is applied. On /news-headlines, the topic to list current headlines on.

tracking_number.description: Carrier shipment tracking number on /package-status. Also accepted as tracking, tracking_id, number, or package_id.

tx_hash.description: EVM transaction hash to look up. Used by /check-tx only.

url.description: Full http or https URL to fetch on /content-extract, or to assess for safety on /url-scan. A whole question containing one is also accepted; also accepted as link, website or target on /url-scan.

venue.description: Chain for /token-total-supply, same as chain (ethereum, eth-mainnet, or a chain id such as 1).

when.description: Optional on /weather-forecast and /storm-alert. The day or window asked about: today, tonight, tomorrow, a weekday name, this weekend, this week, next week, or "the next N days"/"the next N hours". Overrides whatever the question itself implies.

zip_code.description: Address or ZIP code on /carrier-serviceability. Also accepted as address.

ai_generated_likelihood.description: /ai-text-detect only. Approximate 0-1 likelihood the supplied text is AI-generated, a language-model self-assessment, not a certified detector result.

beaufort_force.description: /storm-alert only. Beaufort force of the peak gust.

carrier.description: On /package-status, detected shipping carrier, when named in the input. On /carrier-serviceability and /delivery-window-verify, the carrier name checked, echoed or resolved from the input.

cloud_cover_pct.description: /weather-check only. Cloud cover percentage, when reported.

protocol_total_tvl_usd.description: /tvl only. Total protocol TVL across all chains when both protocol and tvl_chain are supplied.

provider.description: /web-search only. Which search service supplied the answer.

pulse_count.description: /threat-intelligence only. Number of AlienVault OTX threat pulses referencing this indicator.

query.description: Echoes the main lookup value on routes that return it, including TVL, crypto, stock, weather and academic search.

query_type.description: /tvl and /crypto-price only. Which query mode the request used (protocol/chain for /tvl, coin_id/chain_token for /crypto-price).

reachable.description: /url-scan only. Whether the URL responded to a live fetch.

reason.description: Complete fraud answer or wallet-risk explanation. On /task-execution-quality, why the result was judged to satisfy or fail the task.

receipt_status.description: /check-tx only. Explicit receipt outcome, independent of `status`. Null while pending / not found (no receipt exists yet).

recommended_action.description: On /storm-alert, the operational response the risk grade calls for. On /vulnerability-triage, the recommended remediation urgency.

reputation_flagged.description: /url-scan only. Whether web-search reputation checking found malicious reports.

resolved.description: /customer-ticket-resolution only. Whether a real fix or resolution was found.

result_count.description: /web-search, /event-outcome, /news-search, /news-headlines and /cve-lookup. How many web sources or CVE records the answer drew on.

results.description: /cross-chain-state only. Per-chain balance, contract status, and reachability.

retailer.description: /return-policy-verify only. The retailer name, echoed or resolved from the question.

retrieved_at.description: /stock-price only. ISO timestamp when TxLens retrieved the quote, distinct from provider observation time in as_of.

risk_level.description: Named risk grade. LOW/ELEVATED/HIGH/NOT_APPLICABLE on /assess-wallet; LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/SEVERE on /storm-alert.

risk_score.description: Wallet fraud risk on /assess-wallet. On /storm-alert, weather disruption risk on the same 0-1 scale, for callers that threshold rather than branch on the named grade.

search_query.description: /web-search only. The text actually sent to the search index, after an instruction aimed at the miner ("search the web for ...") has been removed from the front of the question.

severe_hail_hours.description: /storm-alert only. Forecast hours with a hail-bearing thunderstorm.

similarity.description: /semantic-similarity only. 0-1 semantic similarity score for the two supplied texts.

snowfall_total_cm.description: /weather-forecast only. Total snowfall across the window.

source.description: On several routes (/currency-exchange, /cve-lookup, /regulatory-filing-monitor, /credit-score-verify, /macro-economic-indicator, /weather-forecast-verify), a plain string naming the data provider. On the fraud/wallet-risk routes, an object with structured detail.

source_count.description: On /crypto-price, the number of independent price feeds that answered. On /research-synthesis and /research-query, how many web sources the answer drew on.

source_note.description: /news-search, /fact-check, /research-synthesis and /event-outcome. Plain-language note on how many sources were used and which ones, kept separate from summary.

sources.description: On /crypto-price, the independent price feeds that answered. On /web-search, /news-search and /fact-check, the pages the answer drew on, each carrying title, url, snippet and the provider's relevance score, in relevance order.

status.description: confirmed/reverted/pending/not_found/error on /check-tx; ok/error on /gas-price and /wallet-balance (live reads have no confirmation states); ok/not_found/error on /token-holders (not_found means the address isn't a known ERC-20 token on that chain, not a failure). Fraud routes may use Sentinel's named verdict. A Sentinel outage is inconclusive rather than a failed HTTP request. invalid_input can be returned by any endpoint and is an answer, not a failure: it means the parameters supplied could not identify anything to look up, and summary explains in plain language what the endpoint needs instead. It is returned with HTTP 200 and no error field, because the input was unusable rather than TxLens being unable to serve.

target.description: /language-translate only. Target language the text was translated into.

temp_max_c.description: On /weather-forecast, the highest temperature across the forecast window. On /weather-forecast-verify, the recorded high for the verified past date. Celsius.

temp_min_c.description: On /weather-forecast, the lowest temperature across the forecast window. On /weather-forecast-verify, the recorded low for the verified past date. Celsius.

thunderstorm_hours.description: /storm-alert only. Forecast hours with a thunderstorm in the window.

title.description: /content-extract only. Page title, or null if none was found.

to_year.description: /academic-search only. Latest publication year applied, whether passed or read from the question.

token.description: /token-holders always; /wallet-balance only when the token param was supplied.

token_decimals.description: /wallet-balance only, when token was supplied. Null if Blockscout didn't recognize the token.

token_name.description: /token-holders always; /wallet-balance only when token was supplied.

topic.description: /web-search only. Which search index answered, whether passed as topic_mode or read from the question.

total_matches.description: On /academic-search, how many peer-reviewed articles matched, of which `papers` is the returned page. On /regulatory-filing-monitor, how many Federal Register documents matched.

triage_tier.description: /vulnerability-triage only. Severity and exploitability tier the CVE was placed in.

truncated.description: On /content-extract, true when the extracted text was cut off at the length cap. On /invoice-ledger-reconcile, true when the supplied description was cut off at the length cap.

tvl_usd.description: /tvl only. Null when status is not_found.

unreachable_reason.description: /ssl-check only. Connection or DNS failure when the host cannot be inspected.

valid.description: /ssl-check only. Null when status is unreachable (the handshake itself failed, so validity is unknown, not false).

valid_from.description: /ssl-check only. ISO timestamp of certificate issuance.

valid_to.description: /ssl-check only. ISO timestamp of certificate expiry.

value_eth.description: /check-tx only. Native-token value in human-readable units. The legacy field name is value_eth, including on Polygon where the native token is POL.

verdict.description: On /fact-check, the True/False/Unverified verdict extracted from the answer. On /chat-complete, Likely/Unlikely/Uncertain for a "will X happen" question, null otherwise. On /url-scan, Safe/Suspicious/Unknown. On /task-execution-quality, satisfies/partially_satisfies/fails.

verified.description: /return-policy-verify only. Whether an actual policy was found and confirmed live.

verified_against_live_ledger.description: /invoice-ledger-reconcile only. Always false. States plainly that this is an arithmetic check over the supplied text, not a lookup against a real ledger system.

when.description: /weather-forecast only. The day or window the answer covers, as understood from the request.

wind_direction.description: On /storm-alert, the prevailing wind direction at the peak, as a compass word. On /weather-check, the compass direction the wind is blowing from right now.

window.description: /news-headlines only. The time window the headlines were drawn from.

window_end.description: /storm-alert only. Local time of the last assessed hour.

window_start.description: /storm-alert only. Local time of the first assessed hour. Starts at the current hour, not midnight.

winner.description: /game-result only. The winning team, or null if the match was a draw or has not concluded.

year.description: /macro-economic-indicator only. The most recent year data was available for.

limitations.message: tx_hash must be exactly 66 characters (0x-prefixed, 64 hex characters).
address must be exactly 42 characters (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters).
token must be exactly 42 characters (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters).
wallet must be a valid 0x-prefixed, 40 hex character EVM address.

name: Sanctions Name Evidence
description: Keyless name screening from official OFAC SDN and non-SDN snapshots with published dates, plus UK entity designations. Returns listed names, aliases, program tags and explainable similarity scores. A name match needs identity review and a negative is not sanctions clearance.

endpoints.description: Screen exactly one person or entity name using ?name=. Matches official primary names and aliases, reordered names and close spelling. The matched boolean is a name alert, not confirmed identity. Lists are dated snapshots; UK coverage is entities only. Do not pass a full question, DOB, wallet address or country in name.

name.description: Person or entity name, not a question or wallet address.

limitations.message: Name must be at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
